units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 19:17">Targ. Y. Ex. XIX, 17</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 30:2">Kel. XXX, 2</cite> <he>תמחוי שעשאו א׳</he> a (glass) plate which is used as window-glass.
<cite ref="Sukkah 45b:5">Succ. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>דמסתכלי בא׳ וכ׳</he> who contemplate (Deity) through a lucid speculum.
Gen. R. s. 91 שראה בא׳ שסברו וכ׳ (play on sheber, grain, and seber, hope) he saw in the glass of prophecy that his hope (Joseph) was in Egypt.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1">Lev. R. s. 1</cite> <he>א׳ מלוכלכת</he> a dim glass (vision); opp. <he>א׳ מצוחצחת</he> polished glass (clear vision).—Pl. <he>אִסְפַּקְלַרְיוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 432:1">Yalk. Lev. 432</cite> <cite ref="A01486"><he>אִיסְפַּקְלַרְיָאוֹת</he></cite>.
